top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Listing (26 TAC §742.405(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The verification of liability insurance was not submitted timely to Child Care Regulation.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of the inspection the primary caregiver s First Aid and CPR certification was expired.

top_violation_types.title: Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §747.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregivers record lacked a notarized affidavit.

top_violation_types.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Not in Charge of Group (26 TAC §744.1107(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: High School caregiver was observed supervising children while caregiver in charge was attending the cafeteria main entrance door.     Operation became in compliance when program director arrived.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass (26 TAC §744.2753(a)(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing a thermometer.
